design.purpose: Open planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; soil depth about 15 cm inside 49 cm long box

steps.c: Cut front and back, each 49 cm
Cut base and ends from board-b
Drill two drainage holes in base
Sand end tops smooth, rounding corners
Stand front on base front edge
Stand back on base back edge
Screw front panel into both ends (4 screws)
Screw back panel into both ends (4 screws)
Screw base up into front and back (4 screws)
Screw base up into both ends (4 screws)
